contexts.text: The honeycomb and broiled fish which the Lord ate with the disciples after His resurrection = the external sense of the Word... the honeycomb, as to its pleasantness...
Arranged like the cells of bees.
Thus honeycomb, or honey = natural good.

The Lord confirmed (that He had glorified His whole Human even to its Natural and Sensuous) by eating before the disciples of broiled fish and also of honeycomb; the broiled fish = the truth of good of the natural and sensuous man; and the honeycomb, the good of truth of the same...
